title: Knee Break Ankle Mobilization
overview: The knee break ankle mobilization is a dynamic stretching drill used to increase the mobility of your ankles.Ankle mobility is extremely important when performing lower body exercises such as thesquat,leg press, anddeadlift.Utilize the knee break ankle mobilization as part of your warm up routine before yourleg workouts.
instructions: In an upright position, position a plate underneath the upper portion of your foot.
Keep your torso erect but bend the knees and allow the ankles to flex as your weight is shifted slightly forward.
Once you run out of range of motion in your ankles, extend the knees back to the start position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Experiment with moving dynamically over one leg versus another or shifting side to side once the knees are bent.
Once you reach end range, focus on contracting the muscle on the anterior portion of your shin (tibialis anterior) to improve control through that new range of motion.
As you progress into using this stretch more routinely, try to resist looking down and learn to control position through kinesthetic awareness rather than visual input.
